messages:
marta: Heads up team 10: Integr8 listing + co-announcement checklist. Need owners for: marketplace metadata, partner badge, co-marketing deck, press embargo distribution, and launch rehearsal. Who's up?

gina: I can do the marketplace metadata (categories, descriptions, screenshots). Will need final screenshots by Thu noon.

rohan: I'll own the partner badge and badge sizing variants. assets-bot, can you confirm we have SVG + 2x PNG exports?

assets-bot: Badge exports available: `integr8-badge.svg`, `integr8-badge@2x.png`, `integr8-badge@3x.png`. Licensing note: third-party icon included; license flagged.

ellie: I'll take co-marketing deck + one-pager. Drafting partner positioning slides now. Need Integr8 logo vector and updated partner quote.

marta: Great. Two dependencies to flag: legal clearance on third-party icon (legal-bot) and Integr8 logo vector (rohan or jess to confirm).

legal-bot: Legal review started for third-party icon. ETA 24-36 hours. Add `marketplace-launch` label for priority.

nate: For tracking: confirm target countries for listing so we can enable correct regional pages. Suggest NA/EU/APAC. Any objections?

gina: NA + EU for launch, APAC soft-launch next week. Need localized short description for FR/DE by Wed EOD.

rohan: Jess from Integr8 has the SVG; pinged her. Also says they'd prefer we use co-branded badge (Integr8 + Redwood) on the marketplace hero.

ellie: For press embargo distribution, do we want a partner-only embargo list first, then broader press? I recommend partner briefing Wed AM, embargo Thu 00:00 UTC. Thoughts?

marta: Partner briefing Wed 9:30 PT works. Embargo Thu 00:00 UTC is fine. leah, can you handle embargo recipients and send to counsel? (not on thread but cc'd).

rohan: Quick technical ask for the listing: the sample deployment template needs a minimal `values.yaml` snippet. ops-bot, can you produce a short snippet we can paste into the marketplace tile?

ops-bot: Sample `values.yaml` snippet generated:
```
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: redwood/edgemorph
  tag: "v1.2.0"
integrations:
  integr8:
    enabled: true
    webhookUrl: "https://hooks.integr8.com/edgemorph"
```

nate: I'll wire the UTM structure: `utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=listing&utm_campaign=integr8_launch`. Also adding a `partner_id=integr8` param to all outbound links.

gina: For screenshots: if creative can't deliver the hero by Thu, fallback is screenshot + badge overlay. Marking that as contingency.

ellie: Rehearsal plan: Fri 15m dry run for listing publish + redirect checks, then 30m partner call for co-announce sequence. Can ops-bot reserve Fri 10:00 PT for the partner call?

ops-bot: Partner call reserved: 2025-06-13T17:00:00Z (Fri 10:00 PT). Dry run scheduled: 2025-06-13T16:00:00Z. Calendar invites sent.

marta: Summary of owners and deliverables:
- gina: marketplace metadata + localized FR/DE short copy (due Wed EOD)
- rohan: badge assets + confirm logo SVG from Integr8 (due Tue)
- ellie: co-marketing deck + press choreography (draft Thu)
- nate: UTM + partner_id mapping (done EOD)
- legal-bot: third-party icon clearance (24-36h)
- ops-bot: sample values.yaml + scheduling (confirmed)

marta: Any risks we missed? If legal clearance fails we strip the third-party icon and proceed; if Integr8 delays logo, we'll use placeholders and update post-publish. All okay?

participants: thumbs? :thumbsup: :eyes:

gina: :thumbsup:

rohan: :thumbsup:

ellie: :thumbsup:
